column1: 1. This Purchase Order is subject to the terms and conditions on the reverse side or attached.
2. Vendor must reference PO number on all invoices and correspondence.
3. Goods must be delivered by the required date or PO may be cancelled.
4. All goods are subject to inspection upon receipt.
5. Invoices must be submitted within 30 days of delivery.
6. Payment will be made according to stated payment terms.
7. Any changes to this PO must be approved in writing.
